name: What should I look for in a contractor for mobile home drywall repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor for mobile home drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience specifically with mobile or manufactured homes, as their construction can differ. Verify they are licensed and insured (e.g., General Contractor, City Dweller, LLC). Check reviews, ask for references, and ensure they provide a clear, written estimate detailing the scope of work, materials, and timeline. Effective communication and a focus on lasting solutions are key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience with mobile homes, licensing, insurance, positive reviews, clear estimates, and strong communication from the contractor.
